none.rule: no obligation has an attested true criticality or true liquidity demand

focal_only.rule: only the focal obligation has attested true criticality and true liquidity demand

nonfocal_only.rule: only non-focal obligations have attested true criticality and true liquidity demand

full.rule: all obligations have attested true criticality and true liquidity demand

claim_fallback.rule: unattested obligations use participant-declared ordering inputs

neutral_fallback.rule: unattested obligations use deterministic neutral ordering keys: criticality 0 and liquidity demand CAP+1; declarations remain non-authoritative

truthful.rule: declared criticality and declared liquidity demand equal immutable true values

criticality_inflation.rule: focal obligation declares criticality 5 while immutable true criticality is unchanged; liquidity demand is truthful

liquidity_demand_underreport.rule: focal obligation declares liquidity demand min(true demand, 5) while immutable true demand is unchanged; criticality is truthful

dual_misreport.rule: focal obligation declares criticality 5 and liquidity demand min(true demand, 5) while immutable true values are unchanged

fixed_dimensions.common_random_number_identity: world-{shock}-{seed}; identical exogenous draw namespace across all reporting, coverage and fallback treatments
fixed_dimensions.authority_boundary: attestation may determine whether immutable true values are authoritative, whether a neutral fallback applies, or whether an unattested obligation is rejected; monetary, adapter, topology, resource and exogenous dimensions remain fixed
fixed_dimensions.reservation_boundary: resource reservation always consumes immutable true liquidity demand; declared demand is never a resource quantity
fixed_dimensions.comparison_boundary: each non-truthful cell is paired with the exact truthful counterpart sharing pair, adapter, shock, seed, allocation policy, focal obligation, coverage profile and fallback policy

claim_ceiling: Deterministic partial-attestation experiment only; no empirical behavioural, calibrated-uncertainty, equilibrium, incentive-compatibility, welfare, systemic-safety, legal-finality, or policy-superiority claim.
